Privacy & Trust

Verified for trust. Private by default. Shared by choice.

Your Privacy. Your Control. Our Commitment.

Building Trust Through Verification

At DebtFreeLately, we collect relevant personal information and the debt details you submit to support review and build greater trust between Broke members and Bros who are willing to help.

We believe that reviewing information helps supporters make more informed decisions. Admin approval does not guarantee that a profile or debt is authentic.

Private by Default

Your privacy comes first. Your real name, age, location, profile photo and story are hidden on your public debt card by default. Your display nickname, debt titles and debt amounts can be shown when your card is approved.

You Decide What to Share

You have control over which eligible profile details you choose to make public using the Privacy & Display settings when creating your card. Your private information does not automatically become public simply because you submit it for review.

Protected Data Access

Account and submitted debt-card information is stored in a database on the app server. Authorized admins can read submitted cards to review them; other members receive only the information selected for public display on approved cards.

Email verification is delivered through Resend. Some prototype features, including saved cards and message drafts, are stored in your browser.

Our Promise

We collect information to build trust, not to take away your privacy.

Your story. Your choice. Your privacy.

1. INTRODUCTION

Your Privacy Matters

At DebtFreeLately, we believe that financial difficulties should never take away a person's dignity, independence, or right to privacy.

DebtFreeLately is an online community platform designed to connect individuals seeking financial assistance ("Broke") with individuals who voluntarily wish to offer support ("Bros").

Our mission is to create a respectful and transparent environment where people can share their financial challenges, tell their stories, and connect with others who may be willing to help.

We recognise that information relating to personal debts, financial circumstances, and life experiences can be highly confidential.

We are committed to handling personal information responsibly and providing users with meaningful control over what they choose to share publicly.

This Privacy Policy explains how DebtFreeLately collects, uses, stores, protects, and discloses personal information when users access our website and related services.

By using DebtFreeLately, you acknowledge that your personal information will be handled as described in this Policy, subject to applicable privacy laws.

We encourage all users to read this Policy carefully before registering an account or submitting personal information.

2. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

DebtFreeLately may collect different categories of information depending on how users interact with our platform.

2.1 Account Information

When registering an account, we may collect:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Username or display name
  • Profile photograph
  • Country or general location
  • Account preferences
  • Selected user role (Broke or Bros)
  • Account verification status

Authentication credentials are processed for account access and security.

2.2 Debt and Financial Information

Users who choose to post a debt may provide:

  • Debt category and description
  • Amount owed and applicable currency
  • Reason for the debt
  • Outstanding balance
  • Personal circumstances related to the debt
  • Supporting financial documents
  • Information about repayment obligations
  • Updates relating to their financial situation

Some documents may contain additional personal or financial information.

Users should avoid uploading unnecessary personal information and should not disclose another person's private information without an appropriate legal basis.

2.3 Supporting Documents

Depending on the features available, we may collect documents such as:

  • Bills and invoices
  • Loan agreements
  • Payment notices
  • Financial statements
  • Debt-related correspondence
  • Photographs or PDF documents supporting a financial claim

We collect such documents to support the review and presentation of debt-related requests.

Uploading a document does not automatically establish that a debt is genuine or verified.

2.4 Community and Communication Information

When using community features, we may process:

  • Messages exchanged between users
  • Debt cards and personal stories
  • Support interests or pledges
  • Saved stories and account activity
  • Reports and complaints
  • Feedback submitted to our team
  • Information voluntarily shared with other users

2.5 Technical Information

When visitors access DebtFreeLately, certain technical information may be collected automatically, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device type
  • Operating system
  • Access times
  • Pages visited
  • Session information
  • Cookies and similar technologies
  • Error logs and security-related activity

We may use this information to maintain website functionality, investigate problems, prevent misuse, and improve our services.

3. HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

DebtFreeLately uses personal information for purposes connected with operating, protecting, and improving the platform.

3.1 Account Management

We may use information to:

  • Create and manage accounts
  • Verify email addresses
  • Authenticate account access
  • Provide password recovery
  • Maintain profile settings
  • Respond to account-related inquiries

3.2 Platform Services

Information may be used to:

  • Enable users to create debt cards
  • Display information users have chosen to share
  • Connect individuals seeking support with potential helpers
  • Facilitate permitted community interactions
  • Maintain account histories and platform functionality

3.3 Trust and Safety

Information may be processed to:

  • Identify suspicious activity
  • Review potentially misleading debt claims
  • Investigate reported users
  • Prevent impersonation and account misuse
  • Enforce community guidelines
  • Respond to suspected fraud

3.4 Communications

We may use contact information to send:

  • Email verification messages
  • Password reset instructions
  • Important security notifications
  • Account-related information
  • Material service announcements
  • Responses to user requests

Optional marketing communications, where offered, will be managed in accordance with applicable law and relevant user preferences.

3.5 Service Improvement

We may analyse relevant platform usage information to understand technical performance, improve accessibility, resolve errors, and develop useful features.

Where practical and appropriate, we may use aggregated or de-identified information for analytical purposes.

3.6 Automated Processing

Certain technical functions may operate automatically, such as account validation, spam prevention, and system security checks.

If DebtFreeLately implements automated systems that make or materially inform decisions significantly affecting users, we will provide the disclosures required by applicable law, including relevant information about the personal data used and the categories of decisions involved.

4. YOUR PRIVACY, YOUR CHOICE

You Control What You Share

At DebtFreeLately, we believe that asking for help should never require someone to surrender their personal privacy.

Users may choose which eligible profile details and story information are displayed publicly, subject to the privacy controls made available by the platform.

4.1 Public Profile Information

Depending on available settings, users may choose to display or hide:

  • Display name
  • Profile photograph
  • General location
  • Personal background
  • Personal story
  • Selected profile details

Information designated as private should not be displayed on public profile pages or debt cards.

4.2 Information Protected from Public Display

The following information is not intended for public display:

  • Account passwords and authentication secrets
  • Private email addresses used for login
  • Private contact details
  • Original identity verification documents
  • Original financial documents designated as confidential
  • Full banking or payment credentials
  • Internal account security information

Access to confidential information must be restricted according to legitimate operational needs.

4.3 Your Public Stories

When users deliberately publish a debt card or personal story, the information they choose to make public may be viewed by other platform users or visitors, depending on the applicable visibility settings.

Users should understand that publicly shared information may be copied, photographed, or saved by other individuals.

Changing visibility settings may prevent further public display through DebtFreeLately but cannot guarantee the removal of copies previously made by third parties.

4.4 Supporter Privacy

Users who provide support should also have appropriate privacy options.

Where supporter recognition features are available, a person's identity or contribution information should be publicly displayed only according to the applicable disclosure settings and permissions.

Private contribution details must not automatically become public merely because a user provides support.

4.5 Changing Your Preferences

Users may update supported privacy settings through their account dashboard.

For privacy choices that cannot be changed directly, users may contact DebtFreeLately to request assistance.

We encourage users to review their privacy settings before publishing personal stories or financial information.

5. DEBT DOCUMENTS AND VERIFICATION

Protecting Sensitive Financial Information

DebtFreeLately may allow users to submit documents supporting their financial circumstances.

We understand that financial documents may include information that could expose users to privacy, identity theft, or financial risks if disclosed improperly.

5.1 Purpose of Document Collection

Documents may be collected to:

  • Support the review of submitted debt information
  • Assess whether a debt request complies with platform rules
  • Investigate suspected misrepresentation
  • Maintain appropriate records concerning reported activity
  • Support identity or debt verification procedures when available

5.2 Document Access

Original documents should be treated as confidential information.

Access should be restricted to authorised personnel or service providers where necessary for legitimate operational, security, or legal purposes.

Submitting a document does not authorise unrestricted publication of its contents.

5.3 Public Evidence

If DebtFreeLately offers a feature allowing users to share supporting evidence publicly, users should be clearly informed before publication.

Public evidence should exclude unnecessary sensitive details, including identification numbers, account numbers, private contact details, and unrelated personal information.

A document's public visibility must be controlled separately from access to the original confidential file.

5.4 Verification Status

DebtFreeLately distinguishes between:

  • Information submitted by a user
  • Documents received by the platform
  • Information reviewed by authorised personnel
  • Information independently verified through an applicable verification process

Submission or review alone does not guarantee that a debt is authentic.

DebtFreeLately must not represent unverified claims as independently verified.

5.5 Misleading or Fraudulent Documents

Where appropriate, we may investigate suspected false documents, inaccurate claims, or misuse of the platform.

Relevant information may be retained or disclosed where necessary and legally permitted to investigate fraud, address disputes, or comply with lawful requests.

6. DATA STORAGE AND SECURITY

How We Protect Personal Information

DebtFreeLately recognises the importance of protecting personal information against unauthorised access, misuse, interference, loss, modification, and disclosure.

We take reasonable steps appropriate to the nature of the information and the risks involved.

6.1 Data Storage

User information may be held in platform databases, secure file storage systems, authentication services, and supporting technical infrastructure.

Certain temporary information, such as interface preferences, locally saved cards, or message drafts, may also be stored on a user's device where the relevant feature uses browser storage.

Information stored only on a device may not automatically transfer to another device and may be lost if local browser data is cleared.

6.2 Security Measures

Security arrangements may include, where implemented and applicable:

  • Secure authentication mechanisms
  • Password protection using appropriate cryptographic methods
  • Encrypted connections
  • Access restrictions
  • Role-based permissions
  • Administrative access controls
  • Security logging
  • Database protection
  • Restricted access to confidential documents
  • Monitoring and incident-response procedures

The specific measures used may evolve as our technology and services develop.

6.3 Security Limitations

No internet-based service can guarantee complete protection against every possible security threat.

Users also have a responsibility to protect their login credentials and report suspicious account activity.

6.4 Security Incidents

If we become aware of a security incident involving personal information, we will assess the incident and take appropriate steps in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

Where required by law, affected individuals and relevant authorities will be notified.

7. HOW AND WHEN WE SHARE INFORMATION

DebtFreeLately does not treat the submission of personal information as unrestricted permission to disclose it.

Information may be shared only for legitimate platform purposes, as described below, or where otherwise permitted or required by law.

7.1 Information You Choose to Share

Information that users deliberately make public may be visible to other users or website visitors.

The scope of visibility depends on the platform features and privacy settings available.

7.2 Service Providers

We may share information with third-party providers supporting services such as:

  • Website hosting
  • Database storage
  • Account authentication
  • Email delivery
  • File storage
  • Security and fraud prevention
  • Customer support
  • Website analytics
  • Payment processing, when enabled

Such providers may process information to perform services on our behalf or under their own applicable legal obligations.

7.3 Legal Requirements

We may disclose relevant personal information when reasonably necessary and legally permitted or required to:

  • Comply with applicable laws
  • Respond to valid legal requests
  • Investigate suspected fraud
  • Protect the rights or safety of users
  • Address security incidents
  • Enforce applicable platform rules

7.4 Business Changes

If DebtFreeLately undergoes a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or transfer of business assets, relevant information may be transferred where lawful and subject to applicable privacy protections.

Users will be informed where notification is required.

7.5 Third-Party Websites

Our platform may contain links to external websites.

DebtFreeLately is not responsible for the privacy practices of independent third-party websites. Users should review the policies of those services before providing information.

8. PAYMENTS AND FINANCIAL INFORMATION

Payment Transparency

DebtFreeLately is intended to facilitate voluntary financial support between individuals seeking assistance and those wishing to help.

Payment functionality may be introduced or expanded as the platform develops.

8.1 Current Platform Status

[Confirm before publication: DebtFreeLately does not currently process live financial contributions through the platform.]

Where a feature records a user's intention or pledge to help, this should not be presented as a completed financial transfer.

8.2 Future Payment Processing

If payment features become available, transactions may be processed through authorised third-party payment service providers.

Depending on the payment service, relevant information may include:

  • Transaction amounts
  • Transaction references
  • Payment status
  • Payer and recipient identifiers
  • Information required to prevent fraud
  • Payment-related compliance records

Payment service providers may collect additional information under their own privacy policies.

8.3 Payment Credentials

DebtFreeLately will explain whether and how payment credentials are collected, processed, or stored before enabling live payments.

Users should not submit complete card details or bank login credentials through ordinary messages, debt descriptions, or document uploads.

8.4 Payment-Related Records

Where financial transactions are supported, certain records may need to be retained to address disputes, investigate fraud, comply with applicable laws, and maintain accurate transaction histories.

8.5 Payment Policy Updates

Before launching live payments, DebtFreeLately will review and update its privacy disclosures and publish relevant payment terms, fee information, and refund or dispute procedures.

Certain technologies may support:

10. YOUR RIGHTS, ACCESS AND DATA DELETION

Your Information Belongs in Your Control

DebtFreeLately respects the rights users may have under applicable privacy laws.

Depending on the relevant jurisdiction and circumstances, users may have the right to:

  • Request access to their personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Change eligible profile visibility settings
  • Request deletion of certain personal information
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
  • Object to certain uses of information
  • Request information about relevant data-processing practices
  • Make a privacy complaint

Some rights may be subject to applicable legal conditions or exceptions.

10.1 Access and Correction

Users may update supported account information through their profile settings.

For information that cannot be updated directly, users may submit an access or correction request through our privacy contact.

We may need to verify the identity of a requester before disclosing or modifying confidential information.

10.2 Account Deletion

Users may request account deletion using an available account feature or by contacting our support team.

Following a valid deletion request, we will assess what information can be deleted or de-identified and what information must or may lawfully be retained.

10.3 Data Retention

Personal information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for legitimate purposes or as otherwise permitted or required by law.

Retention periods may depend on:

  • Whether an account remains active
  • The purpose for which information was collected
  • Security and fraud-prevention needs
  • Outstanding user complaints
  • Transaction or dispute records
  • Applicable legal obligations
  • Backup and recovery requirements

Information that is no longer required will be deleted or de-identified where appropriate and required by law.

10.4 Limits of Deletion

Account deletion does not necessarily remove:

  • Information lawfully required to be retained
  • Certain security or fraud-investigation records
  • Information contained in backups awaiting routine deletion
  • Public information previously copied by independent third parties

We will explain relevant limitations when responding to deletion requests.

10.5 Privacy Requests

Users may submit privacy requests using:

Email: bgm38388@gmail.com

Requests will be considered and answered within the timeframes required by applicable law.
